Unverified blind image reading. No identification of the work was revealed to me in context; none attempted.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001, reduced overview)
- image-001 shows four separate parchment fragments on black ground with a scale ruler (top) and colour chart (bottom right). Pencil shelfmark labels visible: top-right fragment "Stams, STA, Frg. 36-2r" (written in right margin); bottom-left "Stams, STA, Frg. 36-3r"; bottom-right "Stams, STA, Frg. 36-4r"; top-left fragment label at top reads something like "Stams, STA, Frg. 36-1r"? (small, uncertain).
- Top-left fragment: no visible script; surface heavily stained pink/red with brown patches (pigment/paste residue, likely a binding-side surface). Horizontal fold/crease near the bottom.
- Top-right (36-2r): single column, ~17 lines visible, large Gothic textualis bookhand, red paraph marks (red strokes) within lines. Left edge torn (line beginnings lost on lower lines).
- Bottom-left (36-3r): single column, ~17 lines, right side cut/torn (line ends lost), severe abrasion and losses at lower right; large blank left area (margin). Red paraph/initial strokes in some lines. A spatula/tool overlaps the lower right in the photo.
- Bottom-right (36-4r): single column, ~18 lines, same hand; red paraphs and red capital highlights; interlinear glosses in smaller script above several lines (lines 1-6 especially); marginal notes in left margin (two-line note around line 11-12; another near the bottom by a large red initial "Q"). Large red initial Q at near-bottom (line ~17). Right edge cut (line ends lost).
- Interpretation (tentative): continuous prose text in a single column, with later interlinear glossing on 36-4r.
